props.title: India's new algo-trading rules, in plain words

items.h: Under 10 orders per second? You're fine
items.sub: Normal personal automation stays light-touch — no heavy registration.

items.h: Your API key must use a whitelisted static IP
items.sub: A security step to stop anyone else using your access.

items.h: Faster or shared strategies get an “Algo ID”
items.sub: Every real algo order becomes traceable to its source.

items.h: White-box is open; black-box needs a licence
items.sub: Selling a hidden-logic strategy requires SEBI Research Analyst status.

props.caption: The broker is now the responsible principal for every algo on its platform.

props.title: The dates worth knowing

items.sub: The framework is switched on across the industry.
Brokers who aren't ready get cut off from new API clients.
Algo-ID tagging and the complete rulebook apply to everyone.

props.caption: Rules evolve — always confirm the current position on the SEBI and exchange sites.

props.kicker: A REAL SETUP, STEP BY STEP
props.title: From zero to a live-ready account

items.h: 1 — Open a demat account with a compliant broker
items.sub: Zerodha, Angel, Dhan, Upstox, Fyers — all SEBI-registered.

items.h: 2 — Subscribe to their API and get your keys
items.sub: Bind the key to a static IP, as SEBI now requires.

items.h: 3 — Connect in paper / sandbox mode first
items.sub: Every serious API has a test mode. Live there for weeks.

items.h: 4 — Flip to live only when the ladder says so
items.sub: Backtest, walk-forward, paper — then tiny real size.

props.caption: The credentials change from paper to live. Your discipline should not.

props.text: Copying a trader means inheriting their risk — without their reasons.
props.sub: You feel their drawdowns in full, and you can't see when they change their mind.

props.title: Rough monthly cost, by tier
props.note: Figures in ₹ per month, approximate — always confirm on the provider's own page.

props.title: Pick your platform in four questions

items.h: Can I paper trade for free? If not, skip it
items.sub: This is non-negotiable. No sandbox, no deal.

items.h: Is it my existing, trusted, compliant broker?
items.sub: Keep your money where it already lives, under SEBI's rules.

items.h: Does the cost fit how often I'll trade?
items.sub: A monthly API fee only makes sense past a certain activity.

items.h: Can I grow here — from clicks to full code?
items.sub: Choose a place you won't outgrow in three months.

props.caption: The best platform is the boring, compliant one you'll actually stick with.

props.text: Start no-code, keep your money in your own broker, follow the rules.
props.sub: Now the fun part — building your own from scratch.
